It runs printTriangle with stdout redirected into a temporary file and checks BOTH the returned count (size*(size+1)/2) and the printed triangle, which is what makes the check meaningful: a program that returns the right count but prints the wrong triangle, and one that prints correctly but returns the height, were both confirmed to fail.
